title: afla-demux
description: Sorts Illumina or Nanopore FASTQ reads into one set of files per sample using a sample sheet. Education and research use only, not for clinical use.

resources.run_time: Depends on run size; a benchtop run takes minutes.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: illumina: reads hold the index in their names or in I1/I2 files. ont: barcodes are searched for at both ends of each read.

input.title: Reads
input.description: Folder containing the FASTQ files to sort (for Illumina, for example Undetermined_S0_L001_R1_001.fastq.gz; for Nanopore, for example fastq_pass). Sub-folders are searched too.

sample_sheet.title: Sample sheet
sample_sheet.description: Illumina: SampleSheet.csv, or a CSV with sample,index,index2. Nanopore: a CSV or XLSX with sample,start,end (end is optional).

mismatches.title: Mismatches per index
mismatches.description: Differences allowed in each index. The sample sheet is refused if two samples could be confused at this setting.

i5_direction.title: Direction of index 2
i5_direction.description: auto detects it from the reads. forward = as written in the sheet; rc = reverse complement.

max_error.title: Maximum error
max_error.description: Largest edit distance accepted, as a fraction of the barcode sequence length.

min_margin.title: Minimum margin
min_margin.description: The best barcode must be at least this many edits closer than the second best.

search_window.title: Search window
search_window.description: Bases searched at each end of the read.

max_length.title: Maximum length
max_length.description: Longest read kept; 0 means no limit.

require_both_ends.title: Require both ends
require_both_ends.description: Assign only reads with the barcode at both ends.
